leaks.title: Payments land on the owner
leaks.text: No separate payment address is set, so every payment lands on the owner wallet.
leaks.tip: Register a separate payment address that the owner never sends to; fund it from a bridge or a shielded pool.

leaks.title: Owner has more agents
leaks.text: The owner registered 2 other agents; each one can be tied to the others.
leaks.tip: Register each agent from its own owner account if they should not be tied together.

leaks.title: Funding trail
leaks.text: First funded by 0xe18d…c0ff; that wallet also funded 1 other, so they can be linked to you.
leaks.tip: Fund new wallets from a bridge or exchange, not from your main wallet.

leaks.title: Linked wallets
leaks.text: You sent ETH, WETH or USDG to 1 wallet and received from 1 wallet. Each transfer links them to you on-chain.
leaks.tip: Don't send money directly between wallets you want kept apart; go through a bridge or exchange.

leaks.title: Holdings
leaks.text: Anyone can see you hold $54 across 20 coins (we cannot price 18 of them).
leaks.tip: Keep long-term holdings in a wallet you never trade or launch from.

leaks.title: Activity hours
leaks.text: Most of your transactions (90% of 42) happen 08:00–14:00 UTC, which hints at your time zone.
leaks.tip: Spread activity or batch it, so your hours don't show a routine.
